attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Baton Hook
steps: This attack ignores LOS and the |*Stealth| |!innate| superpower, and the defender does not benefit from Cover.
|!hit| |*Pull|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Push it Toward this character |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Devil‘s Deliverance
steps: This attack adds 1 die to each of its attack rolls for each non-Dazed enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character when this attack was chosen.
After each attack is resolved, this character Pushes the defender Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Marvel Knights (Affiliation: Defenders)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, an allied character may reroll a number of its attack dice equal to the number of enemy characters within |!range| 2 of itself.

superPowers.name: Man Without Fear
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. This character Advances Toward the attacker |!movement_small|. Then, if the attacker is within |!range| 2, this character may make a |*Strike| attack targeting it.

superPowers.name: Radar Sense
superPowers.body: When defending against |!physical| or |!energy| attacks, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on Healthy side, and from 6 to 7 on Injured side.

"Baton Hook" now ignores Stealth |!innate| superpower. The Pull special rule triggers after the attack is resolved instead of before the damage is dealt. It now triggers on a |!hit| instead of a |!wild|.
Strength for "Devil‘s Deliverance" increased from 5 to 6. Its first special rule now adds 1 die for each non-Dazed enemy character within |!range| 2 instead of 2 dice.
The |!range| 2 constraint on "Devil of Hell‘s Kitchen" was removed.
A mandatory Advance Toward effect is added to "Man Without Fear", before the new Strike attack.
